name: @saulmarti/specrail
description: Human-approved, evidence-backed software delivery workflow for Codex and Pi coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/ensure-cli-executable.mjs && node scripts/write-build-id.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run version:check && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier quick && node --check dist/src/cli.js && node --check dist/src/runtime-server.js
scripts.version: npm run version:sync && npm run version:check
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run version:check && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier full && node --check dist/src/cli.js && node --check dist/src/runtime-server.js && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm version major && npm publish --access public --tag latest
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm version minor && npm publish --access public --tag latest
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm version patch && npm publish --access public --tag latest
scripts.release:beta:major: npm run release:check && npm version premajor --preid=beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.release:beta:minor: npm run release:check && npm version preminor --preid=beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.release:beta:patch: npm run release:check && npm version prepatch --preid=beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.release:beta: npm run release:check && npm version prerelease --preid=beta && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.test:quick: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier quick
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier unit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier e2e
scripts.test:full: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --tier full
